messages:
Emily K: Hi finance — submitted a corpcard charge from 2025-03-10 showing as `CITYRIDE 837` for €42.80 but vendor portal has no itemized invoice, just a generic charge. I need the VAT/merchant invoice to submit for EMEA reconciliation.
Finance Team: Thanks Emily. Can you paste the transaction screenshot and the MID/booking ref? We can ping the vendor but need details to match.
Emily K: Screenshot: https://imgur.com/a/xxx (mock). Booking ref 9A3-834. Card last4 1234. Charge posted 2025-03-10 22:13 CET. Amount €42.80.
Jon P: tagging @Alan R — company policy requires manager approval for taxi >€25. Can you approve so finance can clear it once invoice arrives?
Alan R: Approved. Fine by me for team travel. :white_check_mark:
Finance Team: Got it — Alan approved. We'll email billing@cityride.co and CC accounting@redwood.com. Template used:

```
Hi CityRide billing,
Could you please provide an itemized VAT invoice for the below charge so Redwood can process a corporate reimbursement and VAT reclaim?
- Card last4: 1234
- Date: 2025-03-10
- Amount: €42.80
- Booking ref: 9A3-834
Please send PDF invoice with vendor VAT number to accounting@redwood.com. Thanks,
Finance Ops
```

Finance Team: Also FYI — if they only provide a receipt without VAT number we may need a supplier self-invoice or additional vendor confirmation for reclaim.
ReceiptBot: Reminder sent to Emily K (60d window) — attach invoice or expense may require manual review.
Emily K: thanks! I replied to their support chat too.
Finance Team: Vendor responded — they asked for the transaction auth code before issuing invoice. Emily can you pull the auth code from your bank screenshot? If not we can request a copy of their POS receipt.
Emily K: auth code is 7F3D91 (on screenshot). Forwarding to vendor now.
Finance Team: Perfect, we sent that. Will update when invoice/ VAT number comes in. If nothing by EOD Friday we'll escalate to vendor account manager.
Alan R: cool — appreciate the quick turnaround.
Emily K: super, thanks everyone :pray:
Finance Team: Closing loop: vendor emailed invoice PDF with VAT ID FR123456789 and attached to accounting@redwood.com at 2025-03-12 09:02 CET. Marked as cleared in Expensify and tagged EUR-travel.
